s.p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: ganacsi la leh iyo ka socda EU, tallaabo tallaabo
s.p.espaces.rg_e2: TARIC: xeerka iyo waajibaadka cusboonaysiinta markaad gasho EU
s.p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (Bankiga Adduunka): bilow ganacsi, canshuuraha, ganacsiga caalamiga ah, dal ka dal
s.p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): hubi in barnaamijku uusan ahayn mid lagu calaamadeeyay maamule ka hor intaadan ku kalsoonaan lacag

s.p.espaces.cu_d6: iyadoo ku xiran alaabta: caafimaad ama shahaadada phytosanitary, liisan, CE heerarka
s.p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: iibiyaha wax kasta oo ka soo baxa warshadda iibinta.
s.p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: iibiyaha wuxuu siiyaa badeecadaha dhoofinta loo oggolaaday xamuulka qaadaha macaamiisha.
s.p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: iibiyaha ayaa maraakiibta saaran; ka dibna, khatarta iyo kharashka waa kan macaamiisha.
s.p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: iibiyaha wuxuu bixiyaa gaadiidka iyo caymiska ilaa dekedda imaanshaha.
s.p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: iibiyaha wuxuu u dirayaa meeshii la doonayo, macaamilku wuxuu bixiyaa canshuuraha soo dejinta.

s.p.espaces.cu_ban: Xayiraadda ama xakamaynta meel kasta: hubka, daroogada, been abuurka, noocyada la ilaaliyo (CITES), qaar ka mid ah daawooyinka. Liiskaas waa la diiday oo waxaa laga yaabaa in lagu wargeliyo (ar).

s.p.espaces.ds_d: Iibso iyada oo aan kayd lahayn: hel alaab-qeybiye, ka shaqeey qiimaha dhabta ah, ku noolaada sharciga.
s.p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping macnaheedu waa iibinta badeecad in alaab-qeybiyeyaasha si toos ah ugu diraan macaamiishaada. Waa fududahay in la bilaabo, laakiin waxaad sii ahaan doontaa mas'uul ka ah iibka.
s.p.espaces.ds_s1: Dooro alaab la oggol yahay dalka macaamiishaada: wax been abuur ah ma jiro, wax sharci darro ahna ma jiro.
s.p.espaces.ds_s2: Hesho alaab-qeybiye ("Wholesale / supplier" liiska halkan ama platforms wholesale) iyo amar tusaale ah ka hor intaadan iibsan.
s.p.espaces.ds_s3: Soo saar qiimaha dhabta ah: badeecadaha, gaadiidka, canshuuraha, VAT ee dalka macaamiisha, kharashka lacag bixinta iyo dib u noqoshada.
s.p.espaces.ds_s4: Ku sheeg macaamiishaada waqtigii dhabta ahaa ee soo dejinta.
s.p.espaces.ds_s5: Ka diiwaangeli hawlgalkaaga: xaaladda ganacsi, VAT iyo canshuuraha sida ku cad dalkaaga (eeg xeerarka ganacsiga).
s.p.espaces.ds_s6: Respect xuquuqda macaamiisha: qiimaha cad oo ay ku jiraan canshuuraha, xaq u soo noqoshada, dammaanad, ilaalinta xogta.
